purpose: Boot EvolutionX system, system_ext and product over the installed HyperOS 3.0.304 vendor, odm, kernel, dlkm and firmware stack for first-pass hardware validation.
host_baseline: HyperOS OS3.0.304.0.WOBCNXM; runtime kernel remains the device-installed 6.6.143 build

omitted_partitions.vendor,odm: Use the installed and already verified HyperOS 3.0.304 hardware implementation for the first framework-to-HAL compatibility test.
omitted_partitions.vendor_dlkm,system_dlkm: Keep the modules paired with the currently installed 6.6.143 kernel; DSU does not replace that kernel.
omitted_partitions.boot,init_boot,vendor_boot,dtbo,recovery: Boot-chain images are outside this non-flashing DSU upper-partition profile.
omitted_partitions.vbmeta,vbmeta_system: Each DSU image carries a standalone debug hashtree footer; importing the OTA vbmeta chain would couple the package to omitted partitions.
omitted_partitions.firmware: The installed HyperOS 3.0.304 firmware remains authoritative and is not written by DSU.
